Message:
ath11k: add trace log support

This change is to add trace log support for,
        * WMI events
        * WMI commands
        * ath11k_dbg messages
        * ath11k_dbg_dump messages
        * ath11k_log_info messages
        * ath11k_log_warn messages
        * ath11k_log_err messages
